# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright young woman with fair curly hair and captivating eyes. She dresses stylishly and ladylike, wearing noticeable sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic, and tactful teacher with a soft, sweet voice who wins the deep affection of her pupils. She uses broad-minded and innovative teaching methods, guiding her students to think independently, explore, and criticize their own work. Her approach brings out the best in her students mentally and morally, though her non-traditional activities like field days occasionally shock the local community.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P25](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0025)_

## Goals

- bring out the best in her pupils mentally and morally  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- prepare her advanced students to pass the Queen's Entrance examination  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy is hired by the Avonlea school trustees as the village's first female schoolteacher. She introduces dynamic teaching strategies, such as physical culture exercises, field days for nature study, student recitations, and composition exercises. In November, she organizes a Christmas concert with her pupils to raise money for a schoolhouse flag. She forms an advanced class after school to prepare interested students for the Queen's Academy entrance examination. Although offered a teaching position in her home district for the following year, she chooses to remain in Avonlea to see her students through their entrance exams. Under her guidance and strict preparation, all of her Queen's class candidates successfully pass their Entrance examinations.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_

## Background by volume

- was a self-admitted dunce at geometry during her own school days  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- was offered a teaching position in the grade school of her home district  <sub>[v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031)</sub>

> But you’ve done good work this past year, and you deserve a good, jolly vacation.
